claim: Min-max normalizes each expert e's full-catalog score vector for user u independently; the 1e-8 constant maps a constant score vector to zero.
Defines the bounded history penalty lambda(u) as 0.10 times the sigmoid of the fourth gate logit z_4.
Fusion-gate training loss: cross-entropy between the scaled fused score vector (expert mixture minus history penalty) and the target item y_u.
Defines user u's chronological interaction history H(u) as the ordered item sequence i_1 through i_{T_u}.
Defines each expert x's output as a full-catalog score vector over all items in I, for x in {seq, cf, sem}.
Defines H_L(u), the suffix of the L most recent interactions with L = min(20, |H(u)|), ordered oldest to newest.
Collaborative-filtering score: recency-weighted (t/L) sum of co-occurrence counts between history items h_t and candidate i, normalized by the square root of item frequencies.
Recency weight r_j decays exponentially with the age (T_u - j) of historical item j, with decay rate gamma = 0.1.
Semantic user representation: the l2-normalized, recency-weighted average of historical item embeddings.
Semantic relevance score for candidate item i is the inner product of the user representation and the item embedding.
Per-user per-expert min-max normalization of expert scores over the full item catalog with stability constant epsilon; preserves each expert's within-user ranking.
Linear map from the 14-dimensional gate feature vector phi(u) producing three expert-weight logits a(u) and one calibration logit b(u).
Expert mixture weights w(u) are the softmax of the expert-weight logits, yielding (w_seq, w_cf, w_sem).
Fused score is the convex combination of the three normalized expert scores under the learned user-specific weights.
History calibration subtracts the bounded penalty lambda(u) from fused scores of items already in the user's history.
Calibration magnitude lambda(u) equals lambda_max times the sigmoid of b(u), bounded in [0, lambda_max].
